messagePairs.name: CO2 Governance Verification State Message Pair
messagePairs.description: Request/response for retrieving CO2's own governance-state gates for a given lot: methodology/GEF currency, parent-REC validity, and allocation reconciliation. Does not return telemetry-layer gates (sensor/gateway/signature/physics/fraud/sequence-integrity) -- those belong to the REC/telemetry evidence layer and are queried via the parent REC's own passport, not this pair.

messagePairs.name: Audit Replay Message Pair (CO2 stage, via REC)
messagePairs.description: Request/response for independently replaying a CO2 passport's own evidence chain from public HCS records (governance spine, passport, confirmation) and confirming each referenced parent REC resolves to a valid record. A caller wanting to continue the replay down into raw telemetry follows the returned recEvidenceRefs into the REC's own passport and audit-replay mechanism -- that second hop is outside this message pair's scope.

messagePairs.name: Lifecycle Transition Message Pair
messagePairs.description: Request/response for recording a lifecycle transition on an issued CO2e tonne-lot unit: mint, transfer, retire, cancel, suspend, or revoke.

messagePairs.name: Registry Passport Reconstruction Message Pair
messagePairs.description: Request/response for registry-layer canonicalization or abbreviation of a CO2e Passport record using the scoped alias profile. This pair is a quasi-verification tool for display and audit workflows: it maps names, preserves unknown fields, reports warnings, and confirms lossless reconstruction. It does not mint, re-sign, default evidence values, or add direct CO2-level telemetry coordinates.
